notes.title: RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0 — We Rebuilt the Core
notes.notes: [h3]RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0[/h3][p][/p][p]Early Access already brought you shared gold, magnet auto-pickup, an effect-opacity slider, double STASH space, faster Lobby speed—the whole nine yards. But you asked for bigger, deeper changes, so we went back to the studs and rebuilt the core.[/p][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p][b]1. Altar of Blessings Reboot[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blessing Levels didn’t carry over between Heroes, so rolling a new character felt rough[/p][/*][*][p]We split Class-Exclusive and All-Heroes rows; every skill stat is now global[/p][/*][*][p]All your Classes’ skill levels merge into one shared level that powers everyone[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]2. Account-Wide Floor Progress[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Classes no longer slog from Floor 1[/p][/*][*][p]Progress is shared up to your highest cleared Floor, so fresh Heroes jump straight into the fight[/p][/*][*][p]Combined with the Altar overhaul, leveling a new Class is a breeze.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]3. Pick Your Difficulty[/b][/p][list][*][p]Choose Normal, Hard, or Nightmare when you enter a floor[/p][/*][*][p]Cruise on Normal or crank it up for fatter rewards[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]4. Juicier Curse-Tier Loot in the CHAOS DUNGEON[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each higher Curse tier now adds extra Magic Item Find Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Bigger risk, bigger loot—dial in the tier that fits your style[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]5. Blessed Skills Twice as Common[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blessed skills pop up 2× more often mid-run, making it easier to lock in your dream build[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]6. Lobby Speed +20%[/b][/p][list][*][p]Movement in the Lobby got a 20 % bump, so it never feels slower than live combat[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the legendary affix [b]\[Phoenix] +1 Resurrection Count[/b] was not applied correctly after acquiring the Phoenix skill.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Highlight Cursor[/b] setting would reset.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p]We built RE-CORE so you can level faster, grow Classes easier, and swim in sweeter loot.[/p][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p][b]To Our Community[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Digging the changes? Hyped for what’s next? Drop us a quick Steam review![/p][p]Your feedback keeps the roadmap rolling, and we’re hammering away on the next big update.[/p][p]Thanks for being awesome.[/p]

notes.title: Week 2 Patch 1.2.2 – Performance Upgrades & Bug-Fix Blitz
notes.notes:
[b]🔧 Week 2 Patch 1.2.2[/b]

[b]📈 Optimization[/b]
• Reduced memory usage and overall performance optimizations
• Refactored skill code that previously caused overloads
• Lower load when wiping all enemies after Resurrection or at the start of boss fights
• Improved data-saving routine
• Various additional optimizations

[b]⚙️ Improvements[/b]
• Better direction detection for Auto Aim when using Warrior and Brawler
• Added “Sell All Items by Rarity” option in the shop
• Fixed some stats not applying after identifying and swapping items during a run

[b]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/b]
• Capped maximum Evasion Chance at 85 %
• Adjusted the maximum split count of the Chain Lightning legendary effect “Split Lightning”

[b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]
• Fixed missing % symbol in Warrior attack bonus at Blessing Altars
• Fixed certain monster effects appearing below stage floor
• Fixed crosshair not appearing when switching to manual aim in Hybrid mode
• Fixed damage-calculation error for Phoenix flames
• Many other minor fixes

⸻
🔍 We continue to monitor stability and optimization.

Please report bugs via the Steam Community or our Discord #bug-report channel.

notes.notes:
[h2]🛠️ Day 7 Update 1.2.0 [/h2]

[b]🧩 QoL Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added indicators for off-screen rare/legendary items, runes, and jewels (toggleable On/Off)
[*] Added UI to display remaining Resurrection and Curse counts in real time during runs
[*] Added display for number of active skills in the Skill Details panel
[*] Added real-time DPS display in Skill Details
[*] Added toggle button to switch between Auto and Manual Targeting when using keyboard
[*] Manual targeting now overrides Auto Targeting if both are used simultaneously
[*] Added Konami code input requirement for Reset Data to prevent accidental resets
[*] Steam Deck: Improved to allow play while offline
[/list][b]🎮 Gamepad[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved stability of the input system
[/list][b]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased chance for items to drop with empty sockets by 33%
[*] Brawler’s Special Attack now deals AoE damage in addition to dash + stun
[*] Adjusted some phases in floor 12 for normal and boss fights
[*] Legendary effect “Mana Harmony” buffed (35% → 50%) and bug fixed
[*] Legendary effect “Reaper’s Manifestation” damage reduction adjusted (45% → 25%)
[/list][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where resurrecting in certain areas caused excessive spawning of ranged/self-destruct enemies
[*] Fixed bug where HP/MP regeneration bonuses were incorrectly applied
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in skill names across some languages
[/list][b]⚙️ Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall game performance improved
[*] Game now auto-pauses when the window is minimized or loses focus
[/list]

⸻
Your feedback and support in Early Access are invaluable.
We’ll do our best to address issues and keep communication open.

Thank you!

notes.title: Responding to Feedback – Hotfix v1.1.0 Rolls Out Today
notes.notes:
[b]May 21 – Hotfix Incoming (v1.1.0)[/b]

First off, thank you all for the incredible support and feedback since our Early Access launch.

We’ve carefully reviewed everything you’ve shared with us over the past day, and we’re rolling out a hotfix, Patch v1.1.0 scheduled to go live on May 21 (within the next 8 hours).

⸻

[b]Main Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Gold is now shared across all characters
[*] You can now collect gold like EXP, and it will be pulled in with magnets
[*] Lowered early stage difficulty
[*] Reduced enemy spawns in certain stages
[*] Increased item and magnet drop rates
[*] Reduced screen flash effect on level-up, among other improvements
[*] Fixed gamepad controller input issues
[/list]

⸻

The full patch notes for v1.1.0 will be posted once the update goes live.

We hear you loud and clear, and we’re doing our best to respond fast and genuinely.

Huge thanks for all the love and support, it means the world to us.

— Tower of Babel Dev Team
